field_text_formatted.value: If you're on Druxt, a module that wires all of this into the build is close behind, for the current Druxt release. It identifies the app as a consumer, reads the settings, and applies the site name and favicon to the document head. It also bakes the whole resolved set into Nuxt's runtime config, so $config.decoupledSettings['system.site'].name works anywhere in the app.
